reading.body:
Adobe reported $23.8 billion in annual revenue as of November 2025 and operates four commercial-use AI products across image, video, and audio generation, all trained on commercially safe data.

The company has moved AI from research into production across its core creative suite. Adobe Express AI and Adobe Firefly handle image generation. Premiere Pro AI extends this to video with generative tools for content extension and color matching. Adobe Podcast AI covers audio enhancement. Each product emphasizes commercial safety in training, a positioning that reflects Adobe's customer base of professional and enterprise users who require legal clarity on training data provenance.

This portfolio reveals how AI embeds into existing software infrastructure rather than replacing it. Adobe does not appear to offer foundation models or standalone inference services. Its AI features integrate into licensed design and video tools that already consume power and compute resources. For data center operators, this means AI workloads added to products customers already use, not new categories of demand.

The data does not cover compute spend, energy consumption, model size, or Adobe's infrastructure footprint. It does not reveal whether Adobe trains models in-house or relies on third parties. California legal exposure registers at 175 instances, but no specific disputes are documented here.

profile_text.body:
Adobe is a public company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, CA, USA, trading under the ticker ADBE. Its most recent revenue filing, a 10-K for the period ending 2025-11-28, reported $23,769,000,000. On its own site, Adobe describes Adobe Express as an all-in-one design, photo, and video tool for making social content, videos, logos, and more, and it describes an AI Assistant that lets users prompt, create, and edit content while keeping parts of a design intact.

Adobe's tracked AI products span several categories. Adobe Express AI is described as lightweight design AI for quick content creation with Adobe Firefly integration and commercial-safe use. Adobe Firefly is an image generation product with a commercial-safe training claim. Premiere Pro AI covers professional video work such as generative extend and color match, also with a commercial-safe training claim. Adobe Podcast AI handles audio enhancement, speech enhancement, and microphone check. Adobe Express for Education is aimed at K-12 teachers and students, with student access by teacher invite or district provisioning, education privacy controls, no ads or paywalls in the K-12 version, and free pricing for K-12 schools and districts.

Among the held facts, Adobe has law exposure recorded in California with a count of 281. No cases, MCP servers, or aliases beyond the name Adobe appear in the record.
